notes: Titles can now be DRAGGED on the preview (like the stickers in Sub_): grab a title and move it freely in both axes — the cursor turns into a move handle over it, and the Horizontal/Vertical sliders follow live. A new 'Horizontal' slider does the same by hand. The render places the title exactly where you dropped it. Titles: new 'Tilt °' slider (like the sticker overlays) — the title rotates around its own centre, so it stays where you placed it, and the preview matches the render. New '⧉ style from captions' link on each title card: one click copies the current caption look (font, colour, case, outline, shadow, plate, line spacing) into that title, then you tweak it. Fix: titles now show in the 'exact' preview too (they were only in the final render), including when a title is on screen but no caption is. Titles got FULL styling to match captions — a '⚙ More styling' block per title with case, alignment, line spacing, text width, outline colour, shadow (on/off, X/Y, blur, colour) and plate colour/alpha/padding/radius. Fix: PNG/.mov overlays now appear and disappear on their in/out in the PREVIEW as well (the render already did; the preview kept them on screen for the whole clip). Titles (was 'Headline') are now a full system: add as MANY titles as you need, each with its own font (any font from fonts/), size, colour, vertical position, outline, optional plate and its own show-from/show-to timing — all baked into the render. Because a title stays text, it's localizable: the LOC tab now has a 'Переклад тайтлів' grid (titles × languages) where you type each language's copy, and every language version renders with its own text. Fonts: you can now keep a family in its own folder (fonts/Poppins/Poppins-SemiBold.ttf) — subfolders are scanned too, and the font picker groups weights under the family name (Regular · Medium · SemiBold · Bold…) instead of a flat wall of filenames. Presets saved before a font was moved into a folder keep working. Animation: it's now clearly marked that only Typewriter survives the render — Pop and Rise are preview-only and show a warning when picked, so nobody ships expecting them. New: 'Text swaps' tablets in Smart captions — add your own transcript swaps (percent → %, workouts → wo) with ＋/✕, no JSON editing; they apply to both Whisper and Scribe. New: 'Time spent (all sessions)' in Settings — accumulated per-operation totals for today / 7 days / all time, with medians, the assembly cache hit rate and an estimate of the encoding time the cache avoided. New: the clip cache now prunes itself (entries unused for 30 days, and a 20 GB budget), so it can't grow forever; the manual Clear cache button stays. Earlier in this build: preview now matches the render exactly (single layout engine), assemble is ~8x faster (a finished body is normalized once and cached, then joined by stream copy), localizable text headlines, per-phrase styles, second word shadow, scrim fade, caption drag on the preview, Safe zones, transcript number/unit clean-up, the Assemble time board, and 'Hold last caption to end'.
